informationNotice: Private Preview information · Billing is in test mode. The billing terms and privacy notice below are drafts for this Preview and require review before public launch.
termsPersonal: <brand/>GO Personal is for individual, manual use. Professional and shared-team use are not included. Fair-use terms are being finalised.
termsWelcome: The free welcome offer is available once per verified account: five successful premium searches across seven days, starting with the first successful premium search. It requires no payment card and does not convert into a paid plan. After the offer ends, two successful new searches remain available per UTC calendar month.
termsTravel: Travel passes are one-time payments for 7, 14 or 30 days. They start when payment completes, have no trial period and end automatically without renewal.
termsSubscription: Monthly and annual subscriptions start when payment completes, with no trial period. They renew at the price shown during checkout until cancelled. Cancel anytime to stop renewal; access continues until the end of your paid billing period. We do not refund unused time, except where required by law.
termsSearch: A successful medicine search includes the information for all returned medicines. Failed requests and reopening saved results do not use another search.
privacyAccount: Your account uses your email address for sign-in. Account access, payment references, and search counts are recorded to manage your welcome offer, free allowance and paid access. The billing ledger does not contain medicine names or search notes.
privacySearch: Medicine names, countries, and any optional details you enter are sent to our AI service provider to generate information. Avoid entering names, contact details or other information that identifies a patient.
privacyBrowser: Searches you explicitly save are stored in this browser, including their medicine information and included-leaflet permission. When you choose to visit Account, your current form and medicine results are temporarily saved in this tab so you can continue afterwards. That temporary draft is removed when restored. Anyone who can access this browser may be able to see saved information.
privacyProviders: The Preview uses Supabase for sign-in and its separate billing database, Stripe for payments, OpenAI for generated information, and Vercel for hosting. Card details are entered on Stripe’s hosted payment pages. External care, map and official-leaflet links take you to the relevant third-party service.
privacyAnalytics: The Preview also loads Google Analytics. Analytics and cookie settings, retention periods, international transfers and the complete privacy notice are being reviewed before public launch.
privacyContact: For privacy questions or an account-data request, contact <support/>.
disclaimerPurpose: <brand/> provides educational medicine and healthcare information. It does not diagnose conditions, prescribe treatment, or replace advice from a doctor, pharmacist or veterinarian.
disclaimerAccuracy: Generated information can be incomplete or incorrect. Confirm ingredients, strength, formulation, availability and suitability with a qualified professional before using or substituting a medicine. Veterinary information concerns animals and should not be used to guide human treatment.
disclaimerUrgent: If symptoms are severe, sudden or worsening, seek urgent medical care. Do not delay care while using <brand/>.
